mapper.select: select id from movie_embeddings where movie_id = #{movieId} and content_type = #{contentType} and is_deleted = 0 order by id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into movie_embeddings ( movie_id, content_type, content_id, embedding, model_name ) values ( #{movieId}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{embedding}::vector, #{modelName} )
mapper.update: update movie_embeddings set content_id = #{contentId}, embedding = #{embedding}::vector, model_name = #{modelName}, is_deleted = 0, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{id}
update movie_embeddings set is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() where movie_id = #{movieId} and is_deleted = 0
